name: Urania Kino (Cineplexx)
notes: cineplexx.at is a JS shell (React SPA) whose app.cineplexx.at API has sessions for cinemaId 1025 but the linked movie ids (HO...) 404 on the movies endpoint — Urania's arthouse programme isn't in Cineplexx's central movie DB. The cinema itself now runs as 'URANIA CEENEMA' with its own server-rendered site at ceenema.eu/spielplan, which lists all published days (title, country, runtime, description, showtime) in one static fetch — used that instead. Site only publishes ~24 days ahead (one calendar page, dates without year, no pagination followed); category not labelled per-film so always null; price never published so price_min/price_text always null.
